genres.label: Literary writing
genres.description: Four Shakespeare tragedies, complete: Hamlet, Othello, King Lear and Macbeth. Spoken text only; speaker names and stage directions removed. Each act is a document.
genres.source: Public domain. Project Gutenberg eBook #100, The Complete Works of William Shakespeare (modernised spelling).

genres.label: Academic writing
genres.description: Research abstracts from four domains: evolutionary computation, image processing, information theory, and knowledge and data engineering. 100 abstracts per domain; each abstract is a document.
genres.source: Published research abstracts, supplied by the project team. Copyright remains with the original publishers.

genres.label: Newspaper writing
genres.description: Telegraph Travel articles by one journalist (Adrian Bridge): three known texts and one unknown (questioned) text, for authorship comparison. Text 4 is Q by default. Website promotions and related-article links removed.
genres.source: The Daily Telegraph (Telegraph Travel), 2012-2014. Copyright Telegraph Media Group; used for research and teaching.

genres.label: Second-language learner writing
genres.description: Synthetic LLM-generated texts imitating intermediate learner essays (including typical errors) for testing. Not genuine learner data.
